commit_message: Add Native 2D authoring transactions and validation
pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0127 native 2D first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Continues ADR 0127 on the current-main baseline by adding GUI-free Sprite Atlas and Tile Map authoring transactions, gesture-level undo/cancel/chunk invalidation semantics, and stricter stable 2D asset validation.
